missing_value_policy.labels: NaN means no supervision. Never imputed, never defaulted.
missing_value_policy.gnomad: Absent from gnomAD is evidence (PM2, AF floor) in feature columns; gnomad_af stays NaN and gnomad_observed = 0.
missing_value_policy.structure: NaN features with structure_available = False; never imputed from neighbours.
missing_value_policy.functional: NaN with functional_assay_available = False; never a feature.
missing_value_policy.genomic: NaN when no ClinVar record exists (DMS/AlphaMissense-only rows).
missing_value_policy.features: Median of the TRAINING fold (vpdl.features.build_feature_matrix), per fold.

withholding_flags.reference_mismatch: reported wild-type residue differs from the UniProt sequence
withholding_flags.clinvar_discordant: ClinVar records for this protein change disagree (P/LP vs B/LB)
withholding_flags.hgvs_inconsistent: ClinVar c. and p. place the change in different codons
withholding_flags.pms2_homology_unconfirmed: PMS2CL homology region (exons 11-15) without orthogonal confirmation
withholding_flags.expert_conflict: expert-panel label contradicts the ClinVar aggregate
